lines.zh: 阴郁林里，我跟着亡者走。
lines.en: In Somber Forest I walk with the departed.
I move on with my head low.
My shadow drags over dry grass.
I pass around an empty stump.
Each step of mine is light.
I pass under the grey trees.
I stop by a headstone.
I walk the wood's edge.
I drift into the clearing.
I shuffle back the way I came.
I cross a shallow ditch.
I follow behind a small procession.
I skirt the puddle slowly.
I walk deeper in.
I stop again and look.
I come out from behind a tree.
I stand in the clearing.
I stand with my head down.
I hear wind through grey branches.
My clothes hang still.
I raise my eyes to the grey trees.
I am inside a silence.

lines.zh: 我站在灰树间，呼出一口白气。
lines.en: I stand among gray trees and breathe out white air.
I look at the trees.
I stand in the clearing, silent.
I slowly close my hands.
I wait for some answer.
I turn my body a little.
I have stood there a long while.
I bow my head and lift it.
My shadow on the ground is faint.
Not even my breath is heard.
I lift my eyes from the ground.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，像在认人。
lines.en: I watch you a long while, as if recognizing you.
I give a slight nod.
You are not from here.
I move half a step nearer.
I part my lips.
I let my face fall again.

lines.zh: 我站在你面前，一言不发。
lines.en: I stand before you without a word.
There is no malice in my eyes.
I gesture for you to stay.
I turn aside to let you pass.

lines.zh: 这片森林里，连石头都是死的
lines.en: Even the stone in this forest is dead
I step back twice.

lines.zh: 我抬手按住被碰的地方
lines.en: I press where it was hit.
I make no sound.
I stand a while with my head down.
My clothes are torn.
I bring my back up bit by bit.

lines.zh: 悲林的亡者，陪我们一起走。
lines.en: The departed of the somber wood walk with us.
I am still here.
I have not gone far.
I look at the trees again.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，没有温度。
lines.en: What you hold has no warmth to it.

lines.zh: 我把它翻过来看，没有收下。
lines.en: I turn it over in my hands but do not keep it.
I reach out slowly.
Then I draw my hand back.

lines.zh: 你递来的东西，我摇头推开。
lines.en: I shake my head and push away what you offer.
I push them back.
I shake my head.
You had better keep them.
I murmur thanks.
I lower my head again.
I turn and walk off.
I take nothing with me.
I leave it on the ground.
I do not touch it again.

lines.zh: 我看着你手里的东西，没有动。
lines.en: I look at what you hold and do not move.
My arms hang still.
You touch me and I turn aside.
I reach out and steady you.
Neither of us opens a mouth.
I make room to one side.
My clothes lift from the knock.

lines.zh: 我慢慢移回原来的地方
lines.en: I drift back to where I stood.
I nod slightly.
I react half a beat late.
I shift aside.
I go back to watching the trees.
She comes over slowly.
We stand abreast before the stone.
She lowers her head too.

lines.zh: 我们一起看向那片灰树
lines.en: We look at the grey trees together.
She rests a hand on my shoulder.
Not one word passes between us.
We stand a long time.
She walks on first.
I follow behind her.
We walk away together.
I bend and pick up a flower.
I lay it before a stone.
I pick up a withered leaf.
I lay it before the headstone.
I pick up a stone.
I set it by the roots.
I brush off the dirt.
I bend, pick it up, and hold it tight.
I put it back.
I take nothing away.
I stop walking.
I turn my face over slowly.
I hear a very light sound.
I look toward the sound.
I give half a step of room.
I slowly lift my eyes to you.
I wait for it to leave.
I do not mean to hide.
I raise my head again.
I look at the grey trees.
I have stayed right here.
I keep watching that way.
It has not come near.
I step slowly aside.
I lift my hand a little.

lines.zh: 我垂着手，目光没离开你。
lines.en: My hands hang low, eyes never leaving you.
It is very quiet here.
It passes behind a tree.
I hear it stop.
I do not move either.
I only raise a hand to block.
Not once have I struck back.
I step back half a pace.
I reach out to touch you, fingertips cold.
I shift back a little more.
I watch it without moving.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间小路，绕着空树桩走。
lines.en: I follow the forest path around an empty stump.

lines.zh: 我的手停在你肩前，没有落下。
lines.en: My hand stops before your shoulder and does not fall.
I still do not strike.
I walk past it.

lines.zh: 我从灰树的影子里出来
lines.en: I come out of the grey trees' shade.
I look over this stretch of wood.
I stand in this clearing.
My shadow is very faint.

lines.zh: 我低头看着地面，哀林里连星石都没有。
lines.en: I look at the ground; Somber Forest has not even stellar stone.
The trees here are all grey.
I raise my head to the treetops.

lines.zh: 我从灰雾里走出来，没有声音。
lines.en: I walk out of the gray mist without a sound.
I nod at those trees.
I walk to the stone.
Firelight falls over the grey wood.
I fall from the slope.
Water closes over my head.
The blast knocks the grey trees down.
Something pierces my clothes.
Spell light scatters over the place.
Too hungry to stand steady.
Lightning splits a grey tree.
The path beneath me is gone.
